messages:
lucy: quick sync — PR #4821 adds a disconnected-site DNS example but the notes about KMS/HSM addressing are ambiguous. do we recommend hostnames or IPs for private KMS endpoints in air-gapped installs?
jun: saw the PR, thanks. can you paste the snippet you're worried about? i can update the wording.
lucy: sure — current example shows a literal IP in /etc/hosts which caused confusion in QA:
```
# /etc/hosts (example)
10.0.2.5 kms.prod.internal
10.0.2.6 hsm-01.local
```
jun: ok — yeah that makes it read like IP is required. for private installs we prefer hostnames + pinned certs where possible. for fully offline sites we still need either a local resolver or /etc/hosts fallback. i suggest clarifying: use hostname + TLS cert, fallback to /etc/hosts only for bootstrap.
nate: also add a note about hairpin/NAT: if the control-plane sits behind SNAT, customers may need hairpin NAT or a NAT loopback to reach internal IPs from same subnet. small diagram could help.
rachel: security note — we should never instruct to skip hostname validation. if using /etc/hosts example, include curl example that uses --resolve or --cacert rather than --insecure. e.g. `curl --resolve kms.prod.internal:443:10.0.2.5 https://kms.prod.internal/health --cacert /etc/kms/ca.pem`
samir: adding HSM detail: PKCS11 path varies by vendor. sample snippet we can add to the HSM section:
```
pkcs11:
  library: /usr/lib/libmypkcs11.so
  token: 'hsm-token-1'
  slot: 0
  pin: '${HSM_PIN_ENV_VAR}'
```
samir: also mention that some HSMs expose management interfaces on a different NIC; call that out so docs remind users to allow that traffic in firewall rules.
emily: tiny docs PR nit — the installation checklist anchor changed from `#networking` to `#networking-and-dns` so a few links in the disconnected-site guide 404. i pushed a commit that updates those two anchors.
jun: perfect. i'll change the hosts example to hostname-first, then show /etc/hosts as a last-resort snippet, add rachel's curl example, and drop nate's hairpin note into the troubleshooting section. samir, can you paste the vendor-agnostic pkcs11 example into the PR thread?
samir: done, pasted a short generic config and added a line recommending vendor docs for slot/pin discovery.
lucy: thank you — will re-run the local smoke docs build. can we also add a short line under "cert provisioning" about cert CN matching the hostname? we've had one customer break because they used the IP CN.
rachel: yes add: "Cert CN must match the hostname used by clients; if using IPs in /etc/hosts, provide a SAN with the IP or prefer hostname-based certs."
jun: noted. i'll squash the commits and request a final review.
deploy-bot: docs-ci: build succeeded for PR #4821 (:white_check_mark:)
emily: LGTM once the hairpin note is in troubleshooting. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
lucy: great! i'll update the product-facing changelog line to say: "clarified KMS/HSM addressing for disconnected installs; added curl + PKCS11 examples and hairpin NAT troubleshooting."
jun: merging after one more quick pass, thanks all :)
